name: ephemeral-ui-kit-tools
description: Tool deps for tools/export-cards.mjs: esbuild bundles the cards; lang-core (same pin as glide frontend/openui/openui-generation) parses --program (zod is its peer, same pin as glide). linkedom runs the DOM tests (override with EUI_DOM_MODULE). ajv validates catalog/ and theme/ files against their schemas in the tests.
